H2300.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) sharp or (figuratively) severe:--be fierce, sharpen.

H2302.def: a primitive root; to rejoice:--make glad, be joined, rejoice.

H2307.def: from «02300»; a peak; Chadid, a place in Palestine:--Hadid.

H2308.def: a primitive root; properly, to be flabby, i.e. (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle:--cease, end, fall, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want.

H2309.def: from «02308»; rest, i.e. the state of the dead:--world.

H2310.def: from «02308»; vacant, i.e. ceasing or destitute:--he that forbeareth, frail, rejected.

H2312.et: from an unused root meaning to sting
H2312.def: from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant:--brier, thorn.

H2313.def: probably of foreign origin; the Chiddekel (or Tigris) river:--Hiddekel.

H2314.def: a primitive root; properly, to inclose (as a room), i.e. (by analogy,) to beset (as in a siege):--enter a privy chamber.

H2315.def: from «02314»; an apartment (usually literal):--((bed) inner)chamber, innermost(-ward) part, parlour, + south, × within.

H2316.def: another form for «02315»; chamber; Chadar, an Ishmaelite:--Hadar.

H2317.def: of uncertain derivation; Chadrak, a Syrian deity:--Hadrach.

H2318.def: a primitive root; to be new; causatively, to rebuild:--renew, repair.

H2320.def: from «02318»; the new moon; by implication, a month:--month(-ly), new moon.

H2321.def: the same as «02320»; Chodesh, an Israelitess:--Hodesh.

H2322.def: feminine of «02319»; new; Chadashah, a place in Palestine:--Hadashah.

H2325.def: also chayab {khaw-yab'}; a primitive root; properly, perhaps to tie, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) to owe, or (by implication) to forfeit:--make endanger.

H2327.def: feminine active participle of «02247»; hiding place; Chobah, a place in Syria:--Hobah.

H2328.def: a primitive root (compare «02287»); to describe a circle:--compass.

H2330.def: a primitive root; properly, to tie a knot, i.e. (figuratively) to propound a riddle:--put forth.

H2331.def: a primitive root; (compare «02324», «02421»); properly, to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show:--show.

H2332.def: causatively from «02331»; life-giver; Chavvah (or Eve), the first woman:--Eve.

H2333.et: properly, the same as (02332) (life-giving, i.e. living-place)
H2333.def: properly, the same as «02332» (life-giving, i.e. living-place); by implication, an encampment or village:--(small) town.

H2334.et: from the plural of (02333) and a modification of (03265)
H2334.def: from the plural of «02333» and a modification of «03265»; hamlets of Jair, a region of Palestine:--(Bashan- )Havoth-jair.

H2335.def: from «02374»; visionary; Chozai, an Israelite:--the seers.

H2336.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to pierce
H2336.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to pierce; a thorn; by analogy, a ring for the nose:--bramble, thistle, thorn.

H2337.def: perhaps the same as «02336»; a dell or crevice (as if pierced in the earth):--thicket.

H2338.et: corresponding to the root of (02339), perhaps as a denominative
H2338.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of «02339», perhaps as a denominative; to string together, i.e. (figuratively) to repair:--join.

H2339.et: from an unused root probably meaning to sew
H2339.def: from an unused root probably meaning to sew; a string; by implication, a measuring tape:--cord, fillet, line, thread.

H2340.def: perhaps from «02333»; a villager; a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine:--Hivite.

H2341.def: probably from «02342»; circular; Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men:--Havilah.

H2342.def: or chiyl {kheel}; a primitive root; properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert:--bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with pain), fear, form, great, grieve, (be) grievous, hope, look, make, be in pain, be much (sore) pained, rest, shake, shapen, (be) sorrow(-ful), stay, tarry, travail (with pain), tremble, trust, wait carefully (patiently), be wounded.

H2343.def: from «02342»; a circle; Chul, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him:--Hul.

H2344.def: from «02342»; sand (as round or whirling particles):--sand.

H2345.et: from an unused root meaning to be warm
H2345.def: from an unused root meaning to be warm, i.e. (by implication) sunburnt or swarthy (blackish):--brown.

H2346.et: act. participle of an unused root apparently meaning to join
H2346.def: feminine active participle of an unused root apparently meaning to join; a wall of protection:--wall, walled.

H2347.def: a primitive root; properly, to cover, i.e. (figuratively) to compassionate:--pity, regard, spare.

H2348.et: from an unused root meaning to cover
H2348.def: from an unused root meaning to cover; a cove (as a sheltered bay):--coast (of the sea), haven, shore, (sea-)side.

H2349.def: from the same as «02348»; protection: Chupham, an Israelite:--Hupham.

H2350.def: patronymically from «02349»; a Chuphamite or descendant of Chupham:--Huphamites.

H2351.et: (both forms fem. in the pl.) from an unused root meaning to sever
H2351.def: or (shortened) chuts {khoots}; (both forms feminine in the plural) from an unused root meaning to sever; properly, separate by a wall, i.e. outside, outdoors:--abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.

H2352.et: from an unused root probably meaning to bore
H2352.def: or (shortened) chur {khoor}; from an unused root probably meaning to bore; the crevice of a serpent; the cell of a prison:--hole.

H2354.def: the same as «02353» or «02352»; Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite:--Hur.

H2355.def: the same as «02353»; white linen:--network. Compare «02715».

H2356.def: or (shortened) chor {khore}; the same as «02352»; a cavity, socket, den:--cave, hole.

H2357.def: a primitive root; to blanch (as with shame):--wax pale.

H2358.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02357»; white:--white.

H2359.def: probably from «02353»; linen-worker; Churi, an Israelite:--Huri.

H2360.def: probably an orthographical variation for «02359»; Churai, an Israelite:--Hurai.

H2361.def: probably from «02353»; whiteness, i.e. noble; Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians:--Huram. Compare «02438».

H2362.def: apparently from «02357» (in the sense of «02352»); cavernous; Chavran, a region East of the Jordan:--Hauran.

H2363.def: a primitive root; to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment:--(make) haste(-n), ready.

H2366.def: or Chushiym {khoo-shem'}; or Chushim {khoo- sheem'}; plural from «02363»; hasters; Chushim, the name of three Israelites:--Hushim.

H2367.def: or Chusham {khoo-shawm'}; from «02363»; hastily; Chusham, an Idumaean:--Husham.

H2368.def: or chotham {kho-thawm'}; from «02856»; a signature-ring:--seal, signet.

H2369.def: the same as «02368»; seal; Chotham, the name of two Israelites:--Hotham, Hothan.

H2370.def: (Aramaic) or chazah (Aramaic) {khaz-aw'}; corresponding to «02372»; to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (i.e. seem):--behold, have (a dream), see, be wont.

H2371.def: or Chazahoel {khaz-aw-ale'}; from «02372» and «0410»; God has seen; Chazael, a king of Syria:--Hazael.

H2372.def: a primitive root; to gaze at; mentally, to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have a vision of:--behold, look, prophesy, provide, see.

H2373.def: from «02372»; the breast (as most seen in front):--breast.

H2374.def: active participle of «02372»; a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval):--agreement, prophet, see that, seer, (star-)gazer.

H2375.def: from «02372»; seer; Chazo, a nephew of Abraham:--Hazo.

H2377.def: from «02372»; a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle:--vision.

H2380.def: from «02372»; a look; hence (figuratively) striking appearance, revelation, or (by implication) compact:--agreement, notable (one), vision.

H2381.def: from «02372» and «0410»; seen of God; Chaziel, a Levite:--Haziel.

H2382.def: from «02372» and «03050»; Jah has seen; Chazajah, an Israelite:--Hazaiah.

H2384.def: from «02372»; a revelation, expectation by dream:--vision.

H2385.et: from an unused root meaning to glare
H2385.def: from an unused root meaning to glare; a flash of lightning:--bright cloud, lightning.

H2386.et: from an unused root probably meaning to enclose
H2386.def: from an unused root probably meaning to enclose; a hog (perhaps as penned):--boar, swine.

H2387.def: from the same as «02386»; perhaps protected; Chezir, the name of two Israelites:--Hezir.

H2388.def: a primitive root; to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer:--aid, amend, × calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

H2389.def: from «02388»; strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent):--harder, hottest, + impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff(-hearted), strong(-er).

H2393.def: feminine of «02391»; prevailing power:--strength(- en self), (was) strong.

H2394.def: feminine of «02392»; vehemence (usually in a bad sense):--force, mightily, repair, sharply.

H2396.def: or Chizqiyahuw {khiz-kee-yaw'-hoo}; also Ychizqiyah {yekh-iz-kee-yaw'}; or Ychizqiyahuw {yekh-iz-kee-yaw'-hoo}; from «02388» and «03050»; strengthened of Jah; Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites:--Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare «03169».

H2397.def: once (Ezek. 29:4) chachiy {khakh-ee'}; from the same as «02336»; a ring for the nose (or lips):--bracelet, chain, hook.

H2398.def: a primitive root; properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn:--bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.

H2399.def: from «02398»; a crime or its penalty:--fault, × grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin.
